name: Abigail Alau R. Sadom
headline: Reliable web applications, built and tested with care.
intro:
Hi, I’m Abigail, a Software Engineering undergraduate at Universiti Malaysia Sabah with a passion for building practical, reliable, and user-focused software solutions. I develop web applications using Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and modern web technologies, with a growing focus on software quality, testing, and system reliability.

From developing a Web-Based Church Management System as my Final Year Project to collaborating on application development projects, I enjoy turning real-world problems into functional, well-structured software. I’m continuously strengthening my skills in software engineering, problem-solving, and quality assurance, with a commitment to writing maintainable code and delivering meaningful digital solutions.

I’m seeking a 2027 internship opportunity in Software Engineering, Web Development, or Software Testing where I can contribute to real-world projects, learn from experienced engineers, and grow into a well-rounded software professional.
photoAlt: Portrait of Abigail Alau R. Sadom
degree: Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons.), Software Engineering
about: I am studying for a Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons.), Software Engineering at Universiti Malaysia Sabah, with graduation expected in 2027.
My interests sit in two places that belong together: building web applications people can rely on, and the software testing and quality assurance that makes that reliability possible.
lookingFor: Software engineering, web development or software testing internships
